prompt:
[REFERENCE CONTROL]

Use the uploaded PART 1 storyboard image for:

“THE LITTLE STRAWBERRY AND THE SLEEPY PINEAPPLE KING”

as the PRIMARY visual reference for:

- exact character identities
- proportions
- expressions
- fruit textures
- costume/accessory design
- fruit-market environment
- throne design
- lighting
- colors
- scale relationships
- props
- story progression

Generate a FINISHED cinematic animated short from the storyboard.

DO NOT animate the storyboard sheet itself.

The finished video must NOT contain:

- storyboard borders
- panel numbers
- timestamps
- handwritten captions
- production notes
- character reference boxes
- prop-reference illustrations
- title/header
- white storyboard paper
- page numbers
- color-note sections

The uploaded storyboard locks:

1. Berry’s exact strawberry-girl design
2. Berry’s red strawberry body
3. Berry’s green leafy top
4. Berry’s expressive large eyes
5. Berry’s tiny scale
6. Kiwi’s exact fuzzy round design
7. Kiwi’s green-brown coloring
8. Kiwi’s exaggerated reaction expressions
9. King Pine’s exact giant pineapple design
10. King Pine’s golden pineapple texture
11. King Pine’s leafy green crown top
12. King Pine’s giant scale
13. King Pine’s peaceful sleeping expression
14. purple cushioned fruit-crate throne
15. Berry’s woven decoration basket
16. grape monocle
17. orange-peel mustache
18. blueberry bow tie
19. citrus crown jewel
20. fruit garlands and berry decorations
21. sparkling fruit cape teaser
22. same warm magical fruit market
23. same golden afternoon lighting
24. Part 1 cliffhanger before King Pine wakes

Translate the 15 storyboard panels into approximately
7–8 COHERENT CINEMATIC SHOTS.

DO NOT create fifteen frantic one-second hard cuts.

Use:

setup
→ discovery
→ first decoration
→ makeover escalation
→ Kiwi panic
→ bigger makeover
→ final cape reveal
→ cliffhanger.

==================================================
VIDEO GOAL
==================================================

Duration:
EXACTLY 15 seconds

Story range:
0:00–0:15

Aspect ratio:
16:9 landscape

Frame-rate feeling:
cinematic 24 fps

Visual medium:
premium painterly 2D storybook animation

Genre:
cozy fruit fantasy comedy

Audience:
family-friendly

Dialogue:
natural synchronized English

Audio:
native dialogue + character sounds + market ambience + playful fruit-decoration sounds + original music

EMOTIONAL ARC:

cozy festival anticipation
→ Berry discovers sleepy king
→ creative idea
→ harmless decorating
→ Kiwi becomes concerned
→ makeover grows ridiculous
→ Berry gets even more ambitious
→ final royal cape cliffhanger

CORE STORY QUESTION:

“What will happen when the Pineapple King wakes up?”

==================================================
PART 1 STORY LIMIT
==================================================

PART 1 ONLY.

START:

The magical fruit market prepares for the evening festival.

King Pine is peacefully sleeping on his throne.

Berry arrives with Kiwi and a basket of decorations.

END:

Berry reveals the FINAL sparkling fruit cape.

King Pine is STILL ASLEEP.

Kiwi realizes Berry is about to make the makeover even bigger.

CUT TO BLACK.

DO NOT show:

- King Pine waking
- King Pine opening his eyes fully
- King Pine standing
- mirror reveal
- King Pine judging the makeover
- King Pine laughing
- King Pine approving Berry
- festival crowd arriving
- final celebration

All of those belong to PART 2.

==================================================
CHARACTER IDENTITY LOCK — BERRY
==================================================

Match the uploaded storyboard EXACTLY.

BERRY:

A tiny anthropomorphic strawberry girl.

Appearance:

- bright strawberry-red fruit body
- visible tiny strawberry seed details
- adorable rounded face
- very large expressive dark eyes
- small smiling mouth
- rosy cheerful cheeks
- green leafy crown/top resembling soft leafy hair
- tiny arms
- tiny legs
- small red dress-like lower silhouette
- petite childlike proportions

Scale:

VERY SMALL compared with King Pine.

Approximately small enough that:

- King Pine’s face is much larger than Berry’s entire body
- Berry must reach/climb to decorate him
- his throne feels enormous beside her

Personality:

- creative
- cheerful
- confident
- mischievous
- imaginative
- completely convinced she has excellent taste
- gentle and caring

PART 1 PERFORMANCE ARC:

0–3 sec:
happy and purposeful

3–5 sec:
creative realization

5–8 sec:
focused tiny stylist

8–11 sec:
increasingly proud

11–13 sec:
fully committed to the makeover

13–15 sec:
huge “one more thing!” excitement

CRITICAL:

Maintain exactly:

- same Berry face
- same strawberry shape
- same green leaves
- same proportions
- same color
- same size
- same visual styling

No redesign.

==================================================
CHARACTER IDENTITY LOCK — KING PINE
==================================================

Match storyboard EXACTLY.

KING PINE:

The giant sleepy Pineapple King.

Appearance:

- enormous rounded pineapple body
- warm golden-yellow skin
- recognizable diamond pineapple texture
- large soft face integrated into fruit body
- thick gentle eyebrows
- large nose
- soft round cheeks
- huge leafy green pineapple crown
- massive friendly scale
- seated on purple cushioned fruit throne

Personality:

- gentle
- regal
- lovable
- incredibly deep sleeper

PART 1 STATE:

ASLEEP THROUGHOUT THE ENTIRE VIDEO.

Allowed:

- slow breathing
- tiny peaceful snore
- subtle body rise/fall
- slight leaf movement
- faint sleepy smile
- tiny nose twitch if desired

NOT ALLOWED:

- fully opening eyes
- speaking
- deliberately moving
- standing
- realizing he is being decorated
- reacting to makeover

All awakening belongs to PART 2.

==================================================
CHARACTER IDENTITY LOCK — KIWI
==================================================

Match storyboard exactly.

KIWI:

Tiny fuzzy kiwi companion.

Appearance:

- small rounded kiwi-fruit body
- muted olive / green-brown fuzzy texture
- large expressive eyes
- tiny dark limbs
- small expressive mouth
- very small compared with King Pine
- approximately Berry’s companion scale

Personality:

- nervous
- cautious
- practical
- dramatic
- loyal
- very expressive

PART 1 PERFORMANCE:

calm
→ suspicious
→ worried
→ alarmed
→ full panic
→ desperate wake-up attempt
→ defeated
→ horrified by final cape idea

Kiwi is the PRIMARY comedy reaction character.

==================================================
PROP LOCK — BERRY’S DECORATION BASKET
==================================================

Maintain the same woven basket from the storyboard.

It contains:

- grapes
- blueberries
- orange peel curls
- citrus slices
- flowers
- ribbons
- fruit medallions
- berry chains
- small fruit jewels
- sparkling fruit cape

The basket should visibly become less full as Berry decorates King Pine.

Do not randomly change its design.

==================================================
MAKEOVER PROP CONTINUITY
==================================================

The decorations must accumulate.

DO NOT reset King Pine between shots.

Order:

1. grape monocle
2. orange-peel mustache
3. blueberry bow tie
4. fruit/flower decorations
5. crown jewel
6. berry/citrus garlands and medallions
7. final sparkling fruit cape TEASER

Once an item has been placed:

KEEP IT THERE.

By the end:

King Pine should look gloriously overdecorated while remaining asleep.

==================================================
GRAPE MONOCLE
==================================================

A playful circular monocle constructed from small purple grapes.

Placed gently around / beside one closed eye.

No glass required.

It remains in position once attached.

==================================================
ORANGE-PEEL MUSTACHE
==================================================

A curled orange-peel decoration shaped like a fancy royal mustache.

Warm orange color.

Soft flexible peel texture.

Placed gently beneath King Pine’s nose.

Cute and harmless.

==================================================
BLUEBERRY BOW TIE
==================================================

A dark blueberry-purple bow tie / berry ribbon decoration.

Placed under King Pine’s face.

Clearly visible in later shots.

==================================================
CITRUS CROWN JEWEL
==================================================

Small ornamental royal accent made from:

- orange slice
- tiny berry accents
- golden-yellow fruit details

Placed among King Pine’s leafy crown.

==================================================
FINAL SPARKLING FRUIT CAPE
==================================================

This is the PART 1 CLIFFHANGER PROP.

Design:

- translucent rosy-pink / citrus-gold fabric
- tiny glowing sparkles
- orange-slice medallions
- berries
- hanging fruit beads
- tiny fruit garlands
- elegant storybook fantasy appearance

At the end of Part 1:

Berry has revealed/unfurled it.

DO NOT complete the full cape placement.

Save that for the beginning of PART 2.

==================================================
ENVIRONMENT LOCK — FRUIT FESTIVAL MARKET
==================================================

Maintain the exact warm magical fruit-market world from the storyboard.

Include:

- wooden fruit stalls
- stacked wooden crates
- baskets overflowing with fruit
- oranges
- grapes
- apples
- berries
- citrus slices
- hanging fruit garlands
- colorful bunting
- warm festival lantern strings
- small plants
- wood shelving
- cozy market details
- gentle depth into background

King Pine’s throne:

- large fruit-crate inspired base
- purple cushioned seat
- large enough for his enormous body

Lighting:

warm golden afternoon approaching festival evening.

Use:

- soft amber sunlight
- glowing string lights
- warm fruit reflections
- gentle rim lighting
- soft shadows

No modern objects.

No humans.

No branded signs.

==================================================
WORLD / MOTION LOGIC
==================================================

The story must follow clear cause-and-effect.

Berry arrives
→ sees sleeping King Pine

King looks plain to Berry
→ Berry gets idea

Berry has decoration basket
→ begins makeover

one decoration succeeds
→ Berry gains confidence

Berry adds more
→ Kiwi becomes worried

Kiwi tries to wake King Pine
→ King continues sleeping

Berry sees makeover
→ thinks it still needs more

basket contains final cape
→ Berry reveals cape

Kiwi realizes Berry is not finished
→ cliffhanger.

==================================================
INTEGRATED_MULTIMODAL_DESCRIPTION
==================================================

[SHOT 1 — 0:00–0:02]
THE FRUIT MARKET BEFORE THE FESTIVAL

Open with a beautiful wide establishing shot.

Warm golden afternoon light pours through a magical fruit market.

Show:

- colorful fruit stalls
- wooden crates
- citrus garlands
- hanging festival lanterns
- baskets of berries
- fruit banners
- cozy decorations

Camera glides slowly through the market.

At the far end:

reveal GIANT KING PINE peacefully sleeping on his purple cushioned fruit throne.

His leafy crown gently leans to one side.

Soft sleepy breathing.

A tiny cute snore.

Berry enters foreground carrying an overflowing woven decoration basket.

Kiwi waddles beside her.

Berry looks toward King Pine.

Dialogue:

Berry, cheerful:
<d>[English] There he is!</d>

Kiwi:
<d>[English] He’s sleeping.</d>

Berry:
<d>[English] Perfect.</d>

Kiwi slowly looks toward Berry.

Suspicious.

CAMERA:

market wide
→ slow forward glide
→ King Pine reveal
→ medium Berry + Kiwi.

AUDIO:

- gentle market ambience
- fruit basket movement
- distant lantern chimes
- soft breeze
- tiny sleepy snore

MUSIC:

light pizzicato strings,
soft marimba,
flute,
gentle whimsical percussion.

==================================================

[SHOT 2 — 0:02–0:04]
BERRY GETS A VERY CREATIVE IDEA

Medium-close view.

Berry walks closer to enormous King Pine.

Scale is important.

She looks tiny beside his giant face.

Berry studies him seriously.

Finger under chin.

She looks at:

King Pine
→ her basket
→ King Pine again.

A tiny sparkle appears in her eyes.

Berry smiles.

Dialogue:

Berry:
<d>[English] Hmm...</d>

Kiwi:
<d>[English] Berry?</d>

Berry:
<d>[English] He needs something.</d>

Kiwi:
<d>[English] A nap?</d>

Berry shakes head.

<d>[English] Style.</d>

Quick comedic music accent.

Camera gently pushes toward Berry’s delighted “big idea” expression.

==================================================

[SHOT 3 — 0:04–0:06]
THE FIRST TWO DECORATIONS

Berry climbs / reaches gently toward King Pine’s face.

No dangerous climbing.

Use a nearby crate or throne edge as a safe step.

First:

Berry carefully places a circular purple grape monocle around one of King Pine’s closed eyes.

Tiny decorative:

TING.

Berry leans back proudly.

Then she reaches into the basket.

Pulls out a curled orange peel.

She gently shapes it beneath King Pine’s nose into an elaborate royal mustache.

King Pine remains completely asleep.

His breathing continues.

Berry whispers:

<d>[English] Much better.</d>

Kiwi stares.

Dialogue:

Kiwi:
<d>[English] Is it?</d>

CAMERA:

macro grape monocle placement
→ Berry reaction
→ orange-peel close-up
→ wider face reveal.

SFX:

- grape bead clicks
- orange peel rustle
- tiny magical chimes
- soft pineapple snore

==================================================

[SHOT 4 — 0:06–0:08]
NOW FOR THE BOW TIE

Berry retrieves a large blueberry-purple bow tie.

She gently attaches it beneath King Pine’s face.

The royal look now includes:

- grape monocle
- orange-peel mustache
- blueberry bow tie

Berry beams.

Kiwi’s eyes widen.

Cut closer to Kiwi.

His expression progresses:

concern
→ disbelief
→ full panic.

Kiwi:
<d>[English] Berry...</d>

Berry:
<d>[English] Hmm?</d>

Kiwi:
<d>[English] I think that’s enough.</d>

Berry looks back at King Pine.

Then at the basket.

Berry:

<d>[English] Almost.</d>

Kiwi’s jaw drops.

MUSIC:

introduce faster playful pizzicato rhythm.

==================================================

[SHOT 5 — 0:08–0:10.5]
THE MAKEOVER ESCALATES

Create a smooth SHORT decorating montage.

Do NOT use frantic cuts.

Berry becomes fully focused like a tiny professional stylist.

Show clear progression:

Berry adds several berries around King Pine’s upper body.

Then a tiny flower.

Then one citrus slice.

Then decorative grape loops.

Then berry medallions.

Then fruit ribbons.

Each addition stays physically present.

King Pine becomes progressively more spectacular.

Kiwi moves around Berry trying to get her attention.

Dialogue:

Kiwi:
<d>[English] Berry!</d>

Berry:
<d>[English] Hold this.</d>

Berry hands Kiwi a small fruit ribbon.

Kiwi automatically holds it.

He realizes what happened.

Kiwi:
<d>[English] Wait—why am I helping?!</d>

Berry continues happily.

CAMERA:

medium decorating shot
→ close prop insert
→ moving side shot across accumulating decorations
→ Kiwi reaction.

MUSIC:

playful escalating comedy rhythm.

SFX:

- berry clicks
- ribbon rustles
- tiny chimes
- flower “pop”
- fruit decoration taps

==================================================

[SHOT 6 — 0:10.5–0:12.2]
KIWI ATTEMPTS A RESCUE

Berry reaches for a tiny citrus crown jewel.

While Berry is focused:

Kiwi looks at sleeping King Pine.

Then at the enormous amount of decorations.

Kiwi decides:

wake him.

Kiwi waddles / hops close to King Pine’s face.

He gently calls:

<d>[English] Your Majesty?</d>

Nothing.

Kiwi tries slightly louder:

<d>[English] Your Majesty!</d>

King Pine gives one adorable sleepy snore.

His body rises and falls peacefully.

The grape monocle stays perfectly in place.

Kiwi freezes.

Then a tiny defeated expression.

Meanwhile Berry gently places the citrus crown jewel among King Pine’s leafy crown.

Berry:

<d>[English] Perfect!</d>

CAMERA:

Kiwi medium
→ sleeping King Pine close-up
→ Kiwi listening
→ crown jewel placement.

No awakening.

==================================================

[SHOT 7 — 0:12.2–0:13.7]
THE FESTIVAL LEGEND

Pull back.

King Pine is now spectacularly decorated.

Visible:

- grape monocle
- orange-peel mustache
- blueberry bow tie
- berry chains
- orange slices
- flowers
- fruit medallions
- citrus crown jewel
- colorful garlands

Berry stands proudly beside her masterpiece.

Hands on hips.

Huge grin.

Dialogue:

Berry:
<d>[English] Ta-da!</d>

Kiwi looks upward at King Pine.

Long silence.

Kiwi:
<d>[English] He looks...</d>

Berry leans forward excitedly.

Kiwi:

<d>[English] ...very decorated.</d>

Berry nods proudly.

<d>[English] Exactly.</d>

Use a gentle wide reveal emphasizing:

tiny Berry
+
tiny Kiwi
+
massive decorated King Pine.

==================================================

[SHOT 8 — 0:13.7–0:15]
ONE LAST IDEA — CLIFFHANGER

Kiwi collapses into a harmless exhausted seated / flattened pose near the decoration basket.

Berry turns toward the basket.

She notices something inside.

Her eyes widen.

A sparkle appears.

Berry:

<d>[English] Oh!</d>

Kiwi slowly looks toward her.

Instant concern.

Kiwi:
<d>[English] No.</d>

Berry reaches inside.

Kiwi:
<d>[English] Berry...</d>

Berry pulls out and dramatically unfurls the FINAL SPARKLING FRUIT CAPE.

The cape opens beautifully in the warm market light.

Show:

- translucent rosy fruit fabric
- orange-slice medallions
- berry beads
- small hanging fruit decorations
- gentle glittering points

Berry’s face becomes pure creative delight.

Berry:

<d>[English] One last thing!</d>

Kiwi’s eyes become enormous.

Kiwi:
<d>[English] ONE MORE?!</d>

King Pine remains completely asleep in the background.

CRITICAL:

DO NOT put the cape fully onto King Pine.

Berry is merely holding/unfurling it.

Camera slowly pushes toward:

Berry
+
sparkling cape
+
panicked Kiwi
+
sleeping decorated King Pine behind.

Music ends on playful suspense sting.

CUT TO BLACK.

END PART 1.

==================================================
AUDIO DESCRIPTION
==================================================

Generate synchronized native stereo audio.

The sound should feel:

- cozy
- playful
- warm
- energetic
- family-friendly
- storybook-like

==================================================
BERRY VOICE
==================================================

Cute youthful girl voice.

Qualities:

- bright
- cheerful
- creative
- confident
- expressive
- warm
- slightly mischievous

Do NOT make her overly baby-like.

Dialogue should be clear and naturally paced.

Most important final line:

<d>[English] One last thing!</d>

Deliver with delighted creative excitement.

==================================================
KIWI VOICE
==================================================

Cute small companion voice.

Slightly higher pitch than Berry.

Qualities:

- nervous
- fast
- expressive
- practical
- comic
- lovable

Performance arc:

beginning:
mild suspicion

middle:
growing concern

later:
panic

ending:
complete disbelief

Final:

<d>[English] ONE MORE?!</d>

is the comedy cliffhanger punctuation.

==================================================
KING PINE AUDIO
==================================================

NO spoken dialogue in Part 1.

Only:

- gentle breathing
- tiny cute snores
- occasional sleepy nose sound
- subtle leaf rustle

No wake-up dialogue.

No reaction words.

==================================================
FRUIT MARKET AMBIENCE
==================================================

Use:

- gentle warm market ambience
- soft breeze
- distant fruit stall activity
- tiny wooden creaks
- baskets moving
- lantern chimes
- hanging garland movement
- subtle leaves rustling

The market should feel populated by life without requiring additional speaking characters.

==================================================
MAKEOVER SOUND DESIGN
==================================================

Each decoration should have a soft signature.

Grape monocle:
tiny grape bead click + delicate TING.

Orange peel:
soft peel curl / fabric-like rustle.

Bow tie:
light berry tap + ribbon flick.

Flowers:
tiny soft pop.

Garlands:
gentle fruit bead rattles.

Crown jewel:
bright but delicate magical chime.

Cape:
soft fabric unfurl +
several sparkling bell tones.

Avoid:

- loud impacts
- slapstick crashes
- aggressive sounds

==================================================
NON-DIEGETIC MUSIC
==================================================

Create an ORIGINAL whimsical storybook score.

Instrumentation:

- pizzicato strings
- marimba
- soft xylophone
- flute
- clarinet
- light hand percussion
- tiny bells
- soft acoustic plucks
- warm strings

MUSIC ARC:

0:00–0:02
cozy festival introduction.

0:02–0:04
curious “idea” motif.

0:04–0:06
tiny stylist playfulness.

0:06–0:08
Kiwi concern begins.

0:08–0:10.5
faster escalating makeover comedy.

0:10.5–0:12.2
brief sneaky Kiwi rescue motif.

0:12.2–0:13.7
warm mini triumph.

0:13.7–0:15
mischievous suspense rise.

End with comic musical sting after:

<d>[English] ONE MORE?!</d>

==================================================
CAMERA LANGUAGE
==================================================

Part 1 camera progression:

0–2 sec:
warm environmental wide.

2–4 sec:
intimate character comedy.

4–8 sec:
decoration details + reaction coverage.

8–12 sec:
more energetic makeover movement.

12–13.7 sec:
large masterpiece reveal.

13.7–15 sec:
tight cliffhanger reactions.

Use:

- slow dolly
- gentle tracking
- macro fruit-detail close-ups
- reaction close-ups
- scale-revealing wide shots
- rack focus
- gentle push-ins
- clean eye-level comedy framing

Avoid:

- crash zoom
- chaotic editing

==================================================
VISUAL STYLE
==================================================

Premium finished painterly 2D storybook animation.

Match the storyboard exactly in spirit.

Use:

- watercolor / gouache inspired rendering
- soft painterly shadows
- beautiful fruit texture
- warm market lighting
- expressive rounded faces
- storybook environmental detail
- subtle depth of field
- soft cinematic bloom
- gentle squash and stretch
- natural secondary motion

The finished video should look like:

THE STORYBOARD ILLUSTRATIONS HAVE COME TO LIFE.

NOT:

- storyboard animatic
- motion comic
- slideshow
- photorealistic fruit
- live action
- realistic food photography
- flat vector art
- generic 3D CGI
- horror

COLOR / LIGHTING
==================================================

Primary palette:

BERRY:
- strawberry red
- leafy green

KING PINE:
- warm pineapple gold
- yellow
- leafy green

KIWI:
- olive green
- fuzzy brown-green

DECORATIONS:

- blueberry blue/purple
- citrus orange

ENVIRONMENT:
- honey gold
- soft wood brown

- muted green
- creamy highlights

Lighting progression:

0–4 sec:
warm natural afternoon.

4–10 sec:
soft golden light + colorful fruit accents.

10–13 sec:
more sparkling festival highlights.

13–15 sec:
final cape receives the brightest magical sparkle.

==================================================
MOTION RULES — BERRY
==================================================

Berry moves with:

- tiny energetic steps
- quick head turns
- expressive hand gestures
- careful decoration placement
- playful little hops
- proud hands-on-hips posture

When handling decorations:

make actions physically clear.

No teleporting props.

No impossible floating decorations unless held or attached.

==================================================
MOTION RULES — KING PINE
==================================================

King Pine stays asleep.

Use:

- slow breathing
- tiny chest/body movement
- subtle leafy crown movement
- slight sleepy smile
- soft snoring

He must remain stable while Berry decorates him.

Do NOT awaken.

==================================================
MOTION RULES — KIWI
==================================================

Use expressive comedy:

- nervous waddling
- quick small hops
- arms spreading
- wide eyes
- head shaking
- tiny panic pacing
- gentle wake-up attempt
- exhausted collapse

Keep physical comedy harmless.

==================================================
CONTINUITY RULES
==================================================

Maintain exactly:

ONE Berry.
ONE Kiwi.
ONE King Pine.

Same:

- character designs
- colors
- sizes
- market
- throne
- basket
- decorations
- lighting direction

King Pine stays seated / reclined in the same throne area.

Berry physically adds decorations.

Do NOT instantly transform him.

Every decoration persists.

By the final shot:

King Pine must still visibly wear:
...
